title: coleus erythraeae
intro: Coleus erythraeae, commonly known as Red Coleus, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its vibrant red or pink flowers and heart-shaped leaves. The health benefits of Coleus erythraeae include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the central nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of Coleus erythraeae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
